name: Thai
caution: 40,378 of the reference words come from a newspaper corpus (Leipzig Corpora Collection, tha_newscrawl_2011_100K, 1.6 million words); 28,879 come from the subtitle list. Written sources are more formal than subtitles and contain more names and foreign words. Frequencies of the corpus-only words come from that corpus and are not comparable with subtitle frequencies. Thai writes no spaces between words, so the word lists come from automatic segmentation (subtitles and a news corpus) and contain some phrases. Letters are counted as written (consonants, vowel signs and tone marks). CV (orthographic): consonant letters C (including อ ว ย, which also serve as vowels), vowel signs V — the pre-posed vowels เ แ โ ใ ไ are written before their consonant and placed after it in the CV string; tone marks, maitaikhu and thanthakhat are skipped; the implied vowels of consonant-only syllables (กด) are not shown, so CV (phonological), learned from the IPA transcriptions, is the better guide. Generated strings follow the writing rules: marks sit on a consonant, at most one vowel sign and one tone mark per consonant, pre-posed vowels followed by a consonant, ั by a final consonant.

english_contamination_removed.rule: Leipzig-only words of 5+ letters that are English words with Zipf >= 4.5

alphabet: กขฃคฅฆงจฉชซฌญฎฏฐฑฒณดตถทธนบปผฝพฟภมยรฤลฦวศษสหฬอฮะัาำิีึืฺุูเแโใไๅ็่้๊๋์ํ
reference_lexicon: plain words (alphabet only) with Zipf >= 2.0 and corpus count >= 3

model.trigram_variants: plain maximum-likelihood letter trigrams with two start markers and one end marker; type counts (each word once) or token counts (each word weighted by its per-million frequency)

filters.not_a_corpus_form: rejected if it occurs anywhere in the corpus word list
filters.phonotactic_legality: initial, medial and final consonant clusters and vowel sequences must each occur in >= 3 reference words

metrics.old20: mean Levenshtein distance to the 20 closest reference words
metrics.logprob: mean log2 probability per letter (incl. word end); model = generating model, all = all-words model

generation.target_rule: per generator and training set: number of training words, between 5000 and 40000
